errors.text_span: the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size
errors.evidence: The statement that the segments are arranged in descending order of size is incorrect. Following the slices clockwise from the largest (ENTITYQUEST, 26.0%), the values are 26.0%, 24.2%, 21.6%, 1.9%, 22.7%, and 3.6%. The sequence is not in descending order, as the 1.9% slice is followed by the 22.7% slice.
